title: C.A.T., Creator of All Tales
text: Our transdimensional Narrator, capable of weaving tales and shaping their outcomes. His belief in free will often precludes the latter impulse.
He calls the failed Assessment one of the constants: a point in the tale that never shifts.

title: Sory'n of Tol
text: A young feline of keen mind and restless spirit. Her need to prove herself is the spark that most often sets her troubles alight.
Brown fur with mocha swirls and a white muzzle.

title: Esteemed Archmage Orachys of Tol
text: Head of the Magical Guild and father of Sory'n. He chases the mastery of spacetime with an obsession that outshadows his obsidian coat.

title: Leba Whitebelly
text: Best friend of Sory'n and a model Guild aspirant. Her colour in the Chorus of Truths is brown.

title: Chartru'el Duskyfur
text: A philosophical silver-gray tom, inclined to pretension. He drew the map of Faelspire. His Chorus colour is silver.

title: Doye Spottedlegs
text: A sharp-witted tabby. His father, M'okto Spottedlegs, is the Guild Guardian of Arcane Secrets and rival to Orachys. Doye's Chorus colour is gold.

title: The Royal House of Greytail
text: King Catophilus Greytail: bombastic, corpulent, devoted to Antidivinian wine.
Queen M'areta Greytail: regal and strategic; the real power.

title: Mother Ertree
text: Spiritual leader of the Strays of the forest. Later canonized as P'thai En'ta Ertree, Our Eternal Matriarch.

title: Ember
text: The fire-panther familiar of Sory'n.

title: The Royal City of Faelspire
text: The eternal Catpital. Within it: Ebon Heights, the Royal Palace, the Corpus, Eastclaw and Northclaw, Felixiata, Hatchery Row, and the Commerce District. The Forest Primeval wraps the southern walls.

title: Aard Voreath Templu
text: The amethyst ziggurat that is the seat of the Guild, up north in Faelspire.
In its east wing lies the refectory, a windowless chamber where Voreathic baubles burn in iron sconces above long benches polished by generations of robed bodies.

title: Mount Sylvest and the Proving Ground
text: Mount Sylvest rises in Faelspire. The Proving Ground lies on its southern slope.

title: The Acatdemy
text: The Acatdemy of Faelspire, with its Amethyst Atrium.

title: Voreathic baubles
text: Infusible amethyst baubles. Sory'n kept a quartet on her dresser, one for each element she once aspired to master.
In the Templu refectory they burn in iron sconces along the walls.

title: The Ascension fresco
text: Above the senior instructors' platform in the refectory hangs a stylized depiction of the Ascension: Leoran's paw stretched skyward, fur like fire, Voreath swirling in fractal ribbons around him, shedding First Era script.

title: The Pact of the Nine tapestry
text: A tapestry that hangs in the Templu. Leba waited for Sory'n beside it before the descent to the refectory.

title: Templu Guardian figurines
text: Paw-sized soapstone renderings of a Templu Guardian, sold by trinket vendors. The one-eyed figurine is a Guild-approved talisman, mass-produced, blessed by a clerk who never conjured a spark in his life.

title: First Era script
text: Script of the First Era, found in circular clusters and running along wall-markings in passages beneath. There must be an entire epic's worth of it down there.

title: The Nekonomicon
text: The grimoire of the Guild. New Magicians paw-print it at their induction ceremony.
One section of it is sealed.

title: Voreath and the Voyd
text: Voreath is conventional magic, which borrows from nature. Voyd magic writes reality.
Pawsitions are the sacred paw forms used in casting. The Null State is the meditative threshold where mind and magic merge. The Nyand is the living ground through which wellsprings bleed.

title: Leoran
text: The Creator, the Endless One. The Mewniverse exists in his mind.
